defs.def: a thing that you are given because you have done sth good, worked hard, etc. 奖励；回报；报酬

ex.s: The D.C. area is home to many outstanding Chinese restaurants, but diners willing to travel outside the city limits will also be rewarded.
ex.t: 华盛顿特区有许多出色的中餐馆，但愿意走出市区就餐的食客也会有所收获。

ex.s: Sometimes, a cleaner living room is the best reward.
ex.t: 有时候，更整洁的客厅就是最好的奖励。

ex.s: We are tempted by sugary treats because our ancestors lived in a calorie-poor world, and our brains developed a response mechanism to these treats that reflected their value — a feeling of reward and satisfaction.
ex.t: 我们会被含糖零食诱惑，因为我们的祖先生活在热量匮乏的世界里，而我们的大脑形成了一种对这些零食的响应机制，反映出它们的价值——一种奖励和满足感。

ex.s: The thing is, regular exercise to get “in shape” requires constant and considerable effort — all for gradual progress and uncertain rewards.
ex.t: 问题是，为『塑形』而进行的规律锻炼需要持续且大量的努力——而这一切只是为了渐进的进步和不确定的回报。

ex.s: This particular feature also means we typically prefer things which offer minimum effort for maximum reward.
ex.t: 这个特别的特征也意味着我们通常更喜欢以最小的努力获得最大回报的事物。

ex.s: Humans care more about immediate rewards.
ex.t: 人类更在意即时奖励。

ex.s: It can be imagined that comparable to the process of building previous scientific models, developing the “computer simulation” metaphor-based model will also be a hugely rewarding exercise.
ex.t: 可以想象，与构建以往科学模型的过程类似，发展这种基于"计算机模拟"隐喻的模型也将是一项极具价值的实践。

ex.s: The approval of others is rewarding, while their disapproval is strongly disliked.
ex.t: 别人的认可是有回报的，而他们的不认可则强烈的厌恶。

ex.s: The mechanism involves a repurposed reward system originally used to develop habits important for self-care.
ex.t: 这一机制涉及一种被重新利用的奖励系统，该系统原本用于培养对自我照顾很重要的习惯。

ex.s: You will harvest the rewards of an artistic life.
ex.t: 你将收获艺术生活的回报。

ex.s: Learning about the requirements of each plant can be very rewarding
ex.t: 了解每种植物的需求会很有收获。

ex.s: Why does Cruse think his voluntary work is rewarding according to the last paragraph? (no more than 16 words)
ex.t: 根据最后一段，克鲁斯为什么认为他的志愿工作有意义？（不超过16词）

ex.s: These elements are called the cue, the routine, and the reward.
ex.t: 这些要素被称为提示、常规和奖励。

ex.s: For example, stress could serve as a cue that one responds to by eating, which produces the reward﹣the reduction of stress.
ex.t: 例如，压力可以作为一个线索，人们以进食来回应它，从而产生奖赏——压力的减轻。

ex.s: "It has been fairly rewarding. ", she says, "a really positive change."
ex.t: 这是相当有回报的，她说，一个真正积极的变化。

ex.s: Understanding the world we live in, and using that knowledge to do useful things, is its own reward.
ex.t: 理解我们所生活的世界，并用这些知识做有用的事，本身就是一种回报。

ex.s: Some days are easier than others, but they’re all rewarding,” said Sullivan.“I might lake a day or two off after the New Year, but that’s it.
ex.t: “有些日子比其他日子轻松，但每一天都很有意义，”沙利文说。“我可能会在元旦后休息一两天，仅此而已。”

ex.s: It is rewarding to try new things.
ex.t: 尝试新事物是有回报的。

ex.s: For Parry, the reward is knowing he hopefully made a difference in a child's life, and except for his drawings on bandages, "they can go on and live their lives and never know I was in it,” he said.
ex.t: 对帕里来说，回报在于知道自己或许改变了一个孩子的人生，而且除了他在绷带上的画，他说“他们可以继续生活，永远不知道我曾经在其中”。

ex.s: To get a reward from the artistic circle.
ex.t: 为了从艺术界获得奖励。

ex.s: However, if others benefit in the process, and I get some reward too, does it really matter where my motivation lies?
ex.t: 然而，如果其他人在这个过程中受益，而我也能得到一些回报，我的动机在哪里又有什么关系呢？

ex.s: It brings her material rewards.
ex.t: 这给她带来了物质回报。

ex.s: For many who made it to Dawson, however, the rewards were worth the difficult trip.
ex.t: 然而，对许多到达道森的人来说，回报值得这趟艰难的旅程。

ex.s: In addition, the team set up a separate experiment that suggested that the baby birds that most closely imitated their mom’s voice were rewarded with the most food.
ex.t: 此外，研究团队还设立了一个独立的实验，表明那些模仿母亲声音最像的幼鸟得到了最多的食物。

ex.s: give priority to economic rewards
ex.t: 把经济回报放在首位

ex.s: If praise is sincere and focused on the effort not the outcome, you can give it as often as your child does something that deserves a verbal reward." We should especially recognize our children's efforts to push themselves and work hard to achieve a goal, "says Donahue, author of Parenting Without Fear: Letting Go of Worry and Focusing on What Really Matters.
ex.t: 如果赞美是真诚的，并且专注于努力而不是结果，那么你可以像孩子做一些值得口头奖励的事情一样频繁地给予赞美。” 我们应当特别承认我们的孩子努力推动自己并努力实现一个目标，即“无恐惧地养育子女：让忧心忡忡地去关注真正重要的事情”的作者多纳休(Donahue)说。

ex.s: Rewards of the job Wildlife photographers have the opportunity to see animals in the wild and help improve people’s understanding of them.
ex.t: 工作的回报：野生动物摄影师有机会在野外看到动物，并帮助提高人们对它们的理解。

ex.s: Building a strong body is the best reward from the sport.
ex.t: 练就强健的体魄是这项运动最好的回报。

ex.s: I occasionally feel lonely, but overall, it’s a hugely rewarding job.
ex.t: 我偶尔会感到孤独，但总的来说，这是一份非常有价值的工作。

ex.s: The Chinese team was rewarded for their perseverance.
ex.t: 中国队因他们的坚持不懈而获得了回报。

ex.s: A day’s work was rewarded with £ 5 in pocket money.
ex.t: 一天的工作换来5英镑零花钱作为报酬。

ex.s: Our content is about real-life topics that are relevant because we know what matters to you is what sticks best You will, find it very rewarding to learn with Lancom.
ex.t: 我们的内容是关于现实生活中的话题，这些话题相关，因为我们知道对你重要的东西才记得最牢。你会发现，和Lancom一起学习非常有收获。

defs.def: an amount of money that is offered to sb for helping the police to find a criminal or for finding sth that is lost 赏格；悬赏金

ex.s: The most rewarding day for our group was project day，when all the efforts we put into collecting the items finally came together．When I saw the various supplies we had collected，it hit me that every kit we were to build that day would eventually be in the hands of an Iraqi child．Over the past four months，I had never imagined how I would feel once our project was completed．While making the kits，I realized that I had lost sight of the true meaning behind it．I had only focused on the fact that it was another school project and one I wanted to get a good grade on．When the kits were completed，and ready to be sent overseas，the warm feeling I had was one I would never forget．
ex.t: 对我们小组来说最有收获的一天是项目日，那天我们为收集物资付出的所有努力终于汇聚在一起。当我看到我们收集到的各种物资时，我突然意识到，那天我们要制作的每一个套装最终都会送到一个伊拉克孩子手中。在过去的四个月里，我从未想象过项目完成后自己会有怎样的感受。在制作这些套装的过程中，我意识到自己已经忽略了它背后的真正意义——我只顾着把它当成又一个学校项目，而且是我想要拿高分的一个。当这些套装制作完成、准备送往海外时，那种温暖的感觉我将永远铭记。

ex.s: It wasn't until he offered to help the boy on the bus that he realized there was something more rewarding he could be doing.
ex.t: 直到他主动提出帮助公交车上的男孩，他才意识到有更有意义的事情可以做。

chunks.en: own / maximum / produces / economic / material reward
chunks.cn: 自己的奖励 / 最高奖励 / 产生奖励 / 经济奖励 / 物质奖励
